verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://www.qapita.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured Qapita overview. Many indexed entries trace back to it, covering cap tables, ESOP, valuations, financial reporting, fund administration and persona pages, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. However, the content is mostly marketing and product summaries (including competitor comparisons) rather than task-oriented agent documentation. Missing for 10: deeper agent-oriented or technical docs (e.g., an llms-full.txt or API/how-to content) and independent or hands-on corroboration of how useful the file is to agents.
